The '''Republic Medical Service''' was the healthcare system of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It provided mobile medical tents, [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]], [[Stimpack/Legends|stimpaks]] and other medical services to citizens of the Republic as well as [[Republic Military/Legends|military personnel]].

It was unknown whether it was related to the [[Republic Medical Corps]], which shared the same task.
